info.name: HW06 FR-04 Personal Profile Management - Stateful Cases
info.description: Dedicated, non-data-driven flows for FR04-AI-031, FR04-AI-046, and FR04-H-005. Run separately from the 41-row input-partition collection so setup and cross-user registration are not repeated per data iteration.

exec: pm.test('Stateful flow login A returns a token', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); pm.environment.set('token', pm.response.json().token); });

pm.test('Stateful baseline A is captured exactly', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); var p = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('baselineProfile', JSON.stringify({ name:p.name, shipping_address:p.shipping_address, phone:p.phone, email:p.email, role:p.role })); });
pm.test('FR04-AI-031 V2 request is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('FR04-AI-031 V3 request is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: FR04-AI-031 GET V3, restore, and verify cleanup

exec: var actual=pm.response.json(); var baseline=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('baselineProfile')); pm.test('FR04-AI-031 final persisted profile is V3', function () { pm.expect(actual.name).to.equal('FR04-AI-031 V3'); pm.expect(actual.shipping_address).to.equal('Address FR04-AI-031 V3'); pm.expect(actual.phone).to.equal('01234567890'); }); pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'PUT',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({name:baseline.name,shipping_address:baseline.shipping_address,phone:baseline.phone})}},function(error,response){pm.expect(error).to.equal(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.be.a('number');pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'GET',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')}},function(e,r){pm.expect(e).to.equal(null);var p=r.json();pm.test('FR04-AI-031 cleanup equals exact baseline',function(){['name','shipping_address','phone','email','role'].forEach(function(k){pm.expect(p[k]).to.eql(baseline[k]);});});});});
pm.test('FR04-AI-046 first identical update is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('FR04-AI-046 second identical update is observable', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.a('number'); });

item.name: FR04-AI-046 GET stable state, restore, and verify cleanup

exec: var actual=pm.response.json();var baseline=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('baselineProfile'));pm.test('FR04-AI-046 final state equals repeated submitted update',function(){pm.expect(actual.name).to.equal('FR04-AI-046 Stable');pm.expect(actual.shipping_address).to.equal('Address FR04-AI-046');pm.expect(actual.phone).to.equal('0123456789');});pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'PUT',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({name:baseline.name,shipping_address:baseline.shipping_address,phone:baseline.phone})}},function(error,response){pm.expect(error).to.equal(null);pm.expect(response.code).to.be.a('number');pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'GET',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')}},function(e,r){pm.expect(e).to.equal(null);var p=r.json();pm.test('FR04-AI-046 cleanup equals exact baseline',function(){['name','shipping_address','phone','email','role'].forEach(function(k){pm.expect(p[k]).to.eql(baseline[k]);});});});});

item.name: FR04-H-005 login user B and capture exact baseline
FR04-H-005 verify A and B, restore A, verify cleanup

exec: var a=pm.response.json();var baselineA=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('baselineProfile'));var baselineB=JSON.parse(pm.environment.get('baselineBProfile'));pm.test('FR04-H-005 A reflects intended mutation',function(){pm.expect(a.name).to.equal('FR04-H-005 User A Changed');pm.expect(a.shipping_address).to.equal('Address FR04-H-005 A');pm.expect(a.phone).to.equal('0123456789');});pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'GET',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('tokenB')}},function(e,r){pm.expect(e).to.equal(null);pm.expect(r.code).to.equal(200);var b=r.json();pm.test('FR04-H-005 B remains exact baseline including nulls and protected fields',function(){['name','shipping_address','phone','email','role'].forEach(function(k){pm.expect(b[k]).to.eql(baselineB[k]);});});pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'PUT',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),'Content-Type':'application/json',Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')},body:{mode:'raw',raw:JSON.stringify({name:baselineA.name,shipping_address:baselineA.shipping_address,phone:baselineA.phone})}},function(re,rr){pm.expect(re).to.equal(null);pm.expect(rr.code).to.be.a('number');pm.sendRequest({url:pm.environment.get('baseUrl')+'/api/users/me',method:'GET',header:{'X-Student-Id':pm.environment.get('studentId'),Authorization:'Bearer '+pm.environment.get('token')}},function(ce,cr){pm.expect(ce).to.equal(null);var p=cr.json();pm.test('FR04-H-005 cleanup restores exact A baseline',function(){['name','shipping_address','phone','email','role'].forEach(function(k){pm.expect(p[k]).to.eql(baselineA[k]);});});});});});
